name: encode_xml
description: Encodes a single-root object as XML, using `@`-prefixed keys for attributes and the `text` key for text content.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The object containing one root element. Keys prefixed with `@` become attributes; the `text` key emits text content.

internal_failure_reasons: `value` must be an object with exactly one root element.
XML element names and values must form a valid XML 1.0 document.
XML text values must be scalar and contain valid UTF-8.
XML elements cannot have array values; use arrays for repeated child elements.
